Metadata.title: Kyandō
Metadata.description: The camp schedule for your coaching team.

Login.tagline: The camp schedule for your coaching team.
Login.title: Sign in
Login.description: Sign in with your email address.
Login.noAccess: No access yet? Ask the camp lead.

Profil.title: Profile
Profil.subtitle: Your account, your language and info about the camp.
Profil.groupsValue: {count, plural, one {# group: {first}} other {# groups, from {first} to {last}}}

Heute.title: My sessions today
Heute.summary: {total, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} · {done} done · {camp}
Heute.campNowEmpty: No session is running right now.
Heute.campNowList: What each group is doing right now

Kalender.title: Calendar
Kalender.subtitle: {camp} · {dates}
Kalender.emptyDay: There are no sessions on this day.
Kalender.emptyWeek: There are no sessions this week.
Kalender.tapHint: Tap a session for location, group and coaches.

Wochenplan.title: Week plan
Wochenplan.subtitle: {camp} · {dates}
Wochenplan.editModeHint: Drag to move · drag the bottom edge to change the length · click an empty slot for a new session.
Wochenplan.unsavedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No unsaved changes} one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
Wochenplan.keyboardHint: Arrow up and down move the session by 15 minutes, left and right by one day. Shift with up or down changes its length.
Wochenplan.discardDescription: {count, plural, one {# change isn’t} other {# changes aren’t}} saved yet. If you discard, the week plan stays as it was.

Gantt.title: Gantt
Gantt.subtitle: All {count} groups · {camp} · {dates}
Gantt.scrollHint: Scroll sideways for the other days.
Gantt.editModeHint: Drag to move, also into another group · drag the right edge to change the length · click an empty slot for a new session.
Gantt.keyboardHint: Arrow left and right move the session by 15 minutes, up and down into another group. Shift with left or right changes its length.

Einheit.title: Session
Einheit.parallelHint: {count, plural, one {# other group} other {# other groups}} from {start} to {end}{more, select, yes {, here are the first three} other {}}.
Einheit.coachCount: {count, plural, =0 {No coaches assigned yet} one {# coach assigned} other {# coaches assigned}}

EinheitForm.conflict: {name} is already assigned to “{title}”{group, select, none {} other { with {group}}} at the same time.
EinheitForm.title: Activity
EinheitForm.shortNameHint: Shown in the week view. 10 characters at most.
EinheitForm.coachesHint: The selected coaches see the session under “Today”.
EinheitForm.deleteDescription: “{title}” will be removed from the schedule. This can’t be undone.
EinheitForm.errorEndBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
EinheitForm.errorForbidden: Only the camp lead can edit sessions.
EinheitForm.deleteHint: Removes the session for all coaches. This can't be undone.
